updates.text: We are excited to announce that Rachel Mago has been promoted to Senior Vice President of Global Sales and Marketing at Taylor Company! In this expanded role, Rachel will assume responsibility for the sales teams in Europe, APAC, and other global service and sales groups. Rachel has a vast knowledge base, endless enthusiasm, and has successfully built deep connections and trust with Taylor partners and customers. One could say that Rachel was destined to work at Taylor. Growing up in the Pacific Northwest, her first job was at the only custard shop in Washington State! That’s not to say she took a direct line to Taylor, though. A Spanish major in college, Rachel moved to Spain to teach English. Returning home and teaching high school Spanish for a year prompted her to explore a career shift to sales. Rest assured, her Spanish fluency is in use and a definite asset to her current global role. Growing up in the PNW fostered her sense of adventure and love of the outdoors, which has led to several foreign hiking adventures with her husband, Johnny. Check out this cool photo of the pair in Iceland! She always up for travel and adding stamps to her passport. At her Chicago home, Rachel enjoys experimenting with recipes, discovering new restaurants, and tackling the most intricate Legos. Of course, she visits her family in the PNW as much as possible. Congratulations, Rachel, on your promotion. We sure hope that custard shop can see you now! Read Rachel’s announcement here: https://lnkd.in/gp7-dQTS #middleby #teammiddleby #thisismiddleby

updates.text: Foodservice organizations are starting to benefit stack their menus to include options full of the nutritional benefits consumers are seeking. From protein-powered coffees to gluten-free buns, high-protein pizza crust and more, now is the time to seek out the benefit-stacked foods you want from the fast food and quick-serve restaurants you love. If you’re a foodservice organization ready to get started, Ardent Mills is here to help. In the August edition of The Stack™, we’re breaking down what we’re seeing in foodservice and sharing the insights that are driving real change across menus. We’re also offering strategies to help you take that first step toward benefit stacking. Whether it’s more protein, whole grains or gluten-free choices, there are solutions available today that can help you stand out and gain consumer loyalty. In this issue you can: • Learn more about the data driving consumer choices • Connect with strategies for integrating more of the benefits consumers want into your menus • Take a look at brands who are leading the way in foodservice benefit stacking Be sure to subscribe to The Stack™ to connect with what’s driving today’s consumers and shaping the products and trends of tomorrow. #TheStack #ArdentMills #FoodTrends #ConsumerInsights #FoodserviceInnovation #FoodserviceIngredients

updates.text: Our team came away from IFT First full of ideas and inspiration for brands who want to benefit stack their portfolios to deliver more of what consumers want from their favorite foods. From added protein and fiber to whole grain nutrition and trusted ingredients, in this issue of The Stack, we’re breaking down the opportunities, watch-outs and key questions to consider when you develop strategies for innovating the products today’s consumers are seeking. We’ve delving into: • What benefit stacking means for customers that want to deliver what consumers demand while staying true to their brand • How to capitalize on the benefit stacking mindset by focusing on what matters today and will continue to matter tomorrow • The key questions to ask your organization as you begin to formulate your innovation strategies • The three most important considerations when benefit stacking It’s about giving consumers more of what they expect, from each and every bite.

updates.text: Are whole grains and pulses factoring into your brand’s innovation strategy? If not, you may be missing a key opportunity to outpace the competition. As more consumers continue to benefit stack – prioritizing foods that deliver multiple nutritional benefits at once – whole grains and pulses are showing up as foundational ingredients for delivering protein, fiber, cleaner labels and affordability. This month in The Stack™, we’re talking with two industry leaders—Ardent Mills Chief Growth Officer Angie Goldberg and Grain Foods Foundation Executive Director Erin E. Ball. They’re breaking down: • The rising momentum of the benefit-stacking trend • The key benefits consumers continue to prioritize • How whole grains and pulses can help connect your portfolio to consumer expectations • What’s next for brands who want to lead in today’s dynamic landscape Be sure to follow The Stack™ to connect with what’s driving today’s consumers and shaping the products of tomorrow. #TheStack #ArdentMills #FoodTrends #ConsumerInsights #CPGInnovation #CPGIngredients

linkedin_company.about: Great Lakes Cheese is an award-winning, premier manufacturer and packager of natural and processed bulk, shredded, and sliced cheeses. As the nation’s leading natural cheese packager, Great Lakes Cheese serves grocery, club and super stores, as well as restaurant chains and foodservice distributors. The company has a national footprint with facilities in Ohio, New York, Tennessee, Utah, Wisconsin, and one under construction in Texas. Family- and employee-owned, Great Lakes Cheese celebrated their 60th year of business in 2018. Great Lakes Cheese was founded by Swiss immigrant, Hans Epprecht, who began his store-door delivery business in 1958. Since then, Great Lakes Cheese has grown to a multi-billion dollar revenue company. The company remains privately owned by the Epprecht Family and over 4,000 dedicated employee-owners. In 1998, the Epprecht Family established an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), which gives all employee-owners a shared 20% stake in the company.

updates.text: Happy #NationalCheeseDay ! 🧀💛 It takes time, tradition, and an incredible amount of dedication to produce your savory favorites—and at Great Lakes Cheese, our family of employee-owners puts that dedication into practice every single day with every package we produce. As the nation’s leading natural cheese packager, we are proud to provide an affordable, nutritious staple that fuels families across the country. In fact, you’ve likely enjoyed our cheese without even knowing it! From the melted perfection on top of a slice from your local pizza shop to the packs you grab off the shelf at your go-to grocer, our hands help craft the products that bring people together. According to the International Dairy Foods Association (IDFA), the American cheese industry has grown into a phenomenal powerhouse, with more than one-third of all U.S. milk production dedicated to cheese. We are honored to lead the way, growing alongside consumer appetites while staying true to the craft and quality behind every single block. From our plants to your plate, thank you for making what we do possible!

Long gone are the days when a restaurant POS was a sleek cash register. Nearly every customer interaction passes through a modern POS in some form, accumulating a continuous record of guest behavior. When guest communication tools like text marketing are built in to that environment to create a unified marketing engine, marketing messages can be defined by what guests have actually done rather than by static assumptions. If marketing tools need to be bolted on to that environment...lime juice and salt. And did you know that text messages have a 95-99% read rate? updates.text: Is it time to renew your POS contract? Before you do, here are a few questions worth asking. Does your POS scale? Your system should grow with you — not force you to rebuild menus and workflows every time you open a new store. Does your POS improve accuracy? Does it handle complex modifiers, a high volume of online orders, delivery, and driver dispatch without slowing you down or causing mistakes? Does your POS integrate? Is your team drowning in tablets? If everything lives in separate systems, that’s a workaround that doesn’t really work. Does your POS give you visibility? Can you see at-a-glance what’s happening across all of your stores and can you trust the numbers you’re seeing? Does your POS make you more visible? The customer data YOU ALREADY HAVE should flow seamlessly into a complete marketing and loyalty system. If you answered “no” to any of these questions, your POS isn’t a partner — it’s a problem, and it may be time to consider a refresh. Looking for a real POS partner? HungerRush is the POS partner behind every great guest experience. Get in touch.

updates.text: "My mule don't like people laughin'. Gets the crazy notion that people are laughin' at him." Burritos are no laughing matter....especially on NATIONAL BURRITO DAY! The word "burrito" means "little donkey" in Spanish, and while the origins of that name are long debated, there's no doubt that the tightly wrapped bundle of goodness does resemble the bedrolls carried by mules and donkeys in the desert-rambling days of yore. The burrito traces its origins to northern Mexican cooking. They were likely born in Sonora, a wheat-growing region where flour tortillas were the default, and were smaller than the overstuffed, foil-wrapped cathedral of fillings that emerged in San Francisco's Mission District in the 1960s. These days you can tell a burrito by its regional dialect. In Tucson, it is a "burro" and filled with machaca. In Texas, it rolls up at high noon, smothered in enchilada sauce, squinting a challenge for you to quick draw your fork. In New Mexico, you might be asked, "red or green?" In San Diego, there might be shrimp in it. In San Francisco, it is nearly the size of an actual donkey. Rice? No rice? Just veggies? Mushrooms? Salmon?!? Like many dishes we have come to wrap our arms around, the burrito is no longer just one thing. The large flour tortilla is a canvas upon which cooks of different cultures and different cities have been painting for over a century. And while we may laugh together over our burritos, we at HungerRush strongly recommend not laughing at them. Because while you might understand that we were just playin' around, the burrito just doesn't get it. If you are a slinger of burritos, today is your day! Looking for more food holidays to celebrate? We have you covered. We put together a comprehensive National Food Day Calendar worth bookmarking: https://hubs.li/Q049swH00

crunchbase.full_description: Smithfield Foods produces and markets packaged meats and fresh pork products for retail, foodservice, and industrial customers across multiple markets. The company’s portfolio encompasses bacon, sausage, ham, hot dogs, deli and lunch meats, dry sausage, and prepared food items, offered under a range of established brand names including Smithfield, Eckrich, and Nathan’s Famous, as well as private-label products. Its operations include processing live hogs into primal and sub-primal pork cuts and transforming meat into finished packaged offerings that are distributed to grocery stores, restaurants, and foodservice outlets. Smithfield Foods also manages hog production through company-owned farms and contract farming arrangements to support its supply chain continuity. The business integrates its production and processing workflows to maintain product consistency and meet diverse customer specifications. It engages with agricultural partners and distribution networks to align supply with demand in domestic and export channels.

updates.text: How do you scale real-time dispatch when demand can exceed processing capacity by nearly 4x? DoorDash engineers rearchitected our dispatch platform from a centralized execution model into a distributed, horizontally scalable system designed for real-time logistics optimization. The new architecture delivers 10x greater throughput, keeps dispatch fast and predictable at peak volume, and creates a foundation for more advanced ML and reinforcement learning in the dispatch loop. In this engineering deep dive, we share how we approached distributed compute, hierarchical decomposition, shadow testing, and production rollout for one of DoorDash’s most latency-sensitive systems. crunchbase.full_description:
Tyson Foods, Inc.® is a modern, multi-national, protein-focused food company. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas, our company has grown from a small regional poultry business into a company that produces approximately 20% of the beef, pork and chicken in the United States. We offer our portfolio of foods under several brands, including Tyson®, Jimmy Dean®, Hillshire Farm®, BallPark®, Wright®, aidells® and State Fair®.

One of the largest food companies in the world, Tyson Foods is also the leading protein provider to many national restaurant chains, including quick service, casual, mid-scale and fine dining restaurants. We make great food for a variety of foodservice customers, including schools, military bases, hospitals, nursing homes and international customers. Tyson Foods is uniquely positioned within the food industry as the only major protein company that sells chicken, beef, pork, and prepared foods products through all major retail distribution channels, including club stores, grocery stores and discount stores.

With more than 133,000 team members worldwide, Tyson Foods combines large-scale production capabilities with a focus on innovation, sustainability, food quality and customer service. We invest in technology, supply chain excellence and environmental stewardship while working to meet the evolving needs of customers around the world.

updates.text: We’ve brought reinforcement learning into DoorDash’s real-time dispatch system to improve batching efficiency while maintaining delivery quality. Trained offline on delayed marketplace outcomes, our RL policy adjusts dispatch objective weights for each merchant. Our existing optimizer handles feasibility and operational constraints. Authors Haochen W. , Yi H. , and Ryan Xie share the engineering behind this deployment. The work was also presented at the ICML 2026 RLxF workshop. updates.text: How do you scale real-time dispatch when demand can exceed processing capacity by nearly 4x? DoorDash engineers rearchitected our dispatch platform from a centralized execution model into a distributed, horizontally scalable system designed for real-time logistics optimization. The new architecture delivers 10x greater throughput, keeps dispatch fast and predictable at peak volume, and creates a foundation for more advanced ML and reinforcement learning in the dispatch loop. In this engineering deep dive, we share how we approached distributed compute, hierarchical decomposition, shadow testing, and production rollout for one of DoorDash’s most latency-sensitive systems. Read the full post: https://lnkd.in/gCaqbmVs

updates.text: DoorDash 🤝 Dispatch Goods 🤝 The Story of Stuff Project We ran a really special pilot in City of Half Moon Bay this year: a dozen restaurants swapped single-use containers for ones that get washed, sanitized, returned, and reused. Thousands fewer containers ended up in the trash. The program’s still running, and we’re still tuning it. But reusable packaging is new enough that half the work is just explaining what it is! Thanks Story of Stuff for helping with that. I hope it gets other cities and restaurants excited to try it too.

updates.text_html:
October is National Pizza Month and we’re celebrating some of the local pizzerias customers love most with our list of 2026 Top Pizza Spots.

And because everyone has an opinion when it comes to pizza, we dug into the data:
- Nearly 30 million pizza orders were placed on DoorDash in 2025
- Pepperoni remains America’s most-ordered topping
- Orders with caramelized onions and meatballs grew more than 120% year-over-year
- Pineapple was ordered more often than olives, bacon, chicken or ham
- New York-style was the fastest-growing major pizza style, up more than 80% year-over-year

From neighborhood institutions to local favorites putting their own spin on a classic, meet the pizza spots customers are loving across America. Full list in the comments.

updates.text: Three months. One rotation. A new career path. Niall M., a Toaster from Customer Care joined R&D Operations for the first pilot of our R&D Rotation Program. This wasn't shadowing. It was real work with real outcomes, backed by a rotation manager and a team invested in his growth. What he took away: → Slow down and ask if it's the right problem before you solve it. → Working well with AI means defining what "good" looks like, then reviewing the output critically. → Nobody does their best work alone. His advice for anyone weighing a leap like this: "Say yes before you feel ready." When a permanent role opened up, he applied. He got it. That's why we run the program. We stretch people, bring fresh eyes to R&D, and build talent from within. Would you take a three-month rotation outside your function? linkedin_company.about: In 1978, Eugene Jetts was on his way to buy a new home when his passion for pizza changed his plans. Instead, he signed a lease on a space in Sterling Heights, Michigan, and, alongside his brother and partner John, opened the first Jetts Party Shoppe & Pizzeria. That family-owned beginning became the foundation for what would grow into Jet’s Pizza®. More than 45 years later, Jet’s remains rooted in its Detroit beginnings, family values and commitment to making great pizza the right way. With more than 400 locations across the country, we’re still focused on the details that have always set us apart: dough made fresh daily, premium mozzarella hand-grated in our stores, quality ingredients and our signature Detroit-style crust, baked until it’s crisp, golden and caramelized around the edges. And while our famous Detroit-style pizza put us on the map, there’s more to Jet’s than square slices. From hand-tossed round, thin-crust and NY Style pizzas to fresh salads, breads, desserts and more, we’re always looking for ways to give our guests something worth coming back for. From one family’s passion for pizza to a growing brand with deep roots in the communities we serve, we’re proud of where we came from — and even more excited about where we’re going. It’s Not Pizza. It’s Jet’s.®

updates.text: Some moments go beyond our stores and remind us just how meaningful our Jet’s family can be. This past weekend, one of our corporate franchise teams came together to support Relay For Life and honor the memory of Julie, a former Jet’s driver and beloved member of their team who lost her battle with cancer on August 8th. Store leadership Victoria, Andrew, Alexis, and Kaycie came together to honor Julie, with Kaycie carrying a particularly personal connection as Julie’s daughter. In Julie’s memory, the team donated $1,000 to the American Cancer Society and joined their community in supporting a cause that touches so many lives. We’re grateful to see our teams show up for one another and the communities they’re part of. We’re honored to share Julie’s story and celebrate the impact she had on those around her. We’ll be cheering them on as they return for Relay For Life next year. 💜 #RelayForLife #JetsPizza #CommunityImpact

updates.text: Some of the best high school memories happen after the final whistle. 🏆🍕 That’s why we’re proud to be named the Official Pizza of the Michigan High School Athletic Association (MHSAA). Born in Sterling Heights in 1978, Jet’s has grown across the country, but Michigan will always be home. And there’s something special about the way high school sports bring Michigan communities together, from Friday night lights to state championship celebrations. Through this multiyear partnership, we’ll be celebrating the student-athletes, coaches, teams, and communities that make Michigan high school sports so special. Throughout the school year, the MHSAA will recognize a Team of the Month, and we’ll be celebrating each honoree with a Jet’s Pizza party and a spotlight across our social channels. Here’s to the teams, the towns, the traditions, and all the memories still to be made! Michigan, we’re proud to be in your corner. 💙 #JetsPizza #MHSAA #MichiganHighSchoolSports #Michigan

updates.text: Grubhub is proud to be recognized with the UserTesting Illumi Award for Emerging Innovator — and it came out of one of the biggest moments of our year. We recently made a bold move: removing delivery and service fees on restaurant orders over $50, supported by a campaign during the Big Game. As soon as the campaign launched, we ran three parallel research studies to capture real-time customer reactions. Within 48 hours, we had clear feedback. Customers were excited about the offer, but we identified opportunities to make the experience even stronger. Teams across the business moved quickly to update parts of the app and campaign creative while the campaign was still live. That fast feedback loop helped us improve the customer experience during a high-visibility moment — driving stronger AOV, better brand perception, and a campaign that delivered on its promise. The combination of customer insight, speed, and cross-functional execution helped turn a bold idea into meaningful business impact.

linkedin_company.about: ABOUT LITTLE CAESARS® Little Caesars, the Best Value in Pizza*, was founded by Mike and Marian Ilitch as a single, family-owned restaurant in 1959 and is headquartered in downtown Detroit, Michigan. It is the third-largest pizza chain in the world, with restaurants in each of the 50 U.S. states and 31 countries and territories. Known for its HOT-N-READY® pizza, Crazy Puffs®, and famed Crazy Bread®, Little Caesars uses quality ingredients, like fresh, never-frozen mozzarella and Muenster cheese and sauce made from fresh-packed, vine-ripened California crushed tomatoes. The brand is known for innovation and is home to the exclusive Pizza Portal® pickup, a heated, self-service mobile order pickup station. Little Caesars is also the Official Pizza Sponsor of the NFL. A high-growth company with over 65 years in the $150 billion worldwide pizza industry, Little Caesars continually looks for franchisee candidates to join the team in markets worldwide. In addition to providing the opportunity for entrepreneurial independence in a franchise system, Little Caesars offers a simple operating system, a reputation for taste and value, and strong brand awareness with one of the most recognized characters in the country, Little Caesar. Little Caesars is proud to be part of the Ilitch Companies family of businesses. For more, visit LittleCaesars.com and follow Little Caesars on TikTok, Instagram, and X. *Limited to top 4 national pizza chains

updates.text: A POS without built-in text marketing is like a margarita without tequila. It's basically just a glass full of lime juice and salt. Long gone are the days when a restaurant POS was a sleek cash register. Nearly every customer interaction passes through a modern POS in some form, accumulating a continuous record of guest behavior. When guest communication tools like text marketing are built in to that environment to create a unified marketing engine, marketing messages can be defined by what guests have actually done rather than by static assumptions. If marketing tools need to be bolted on to that environment...lime juice and salt. And did you know that text messages have a 95-99% read rate? For more delicious stats and more about how a modern POS can take advantage of customer behavior data to drive growth, check out this article on SourceForge .

updates.text: Is it time to renew your POS contract? Before you do, here are a few questions worth asking. Does your POS scale? Your system should grow with you — not force you to rebuild menus and workflows every time you open a new store. Does your POS improve accuracy? Does it handle complex modifiers, a high volume of online orders, delivery, and driver dispatch without slowing you down or causing mistakes? Does your POS integrate? Is your team drowning in tablets? If everything lives in separate systems, that’s a workaround that doesn’t really work. Does your POS give you visibility? Can you see at-a-glance what’s happening across all of your stores and can you trust the numbers you’re seeing? Does your POS make you more visible? The customer data YOU ALREADY HAVE should flow seamlessly into a complete marketing and loyalty system. If you answered “no” to any of these questions, your POS isn’t a partner — it’s a problem, and it may be time to consider a refresh. Looking for a real POS partner? HungerRush is the POS partner behind every great guest experience. Get in touch.

And tomato soup? Like Batman and Robin, Lucy and Ethel, Mario and Luigi, Frodo and Samwise, Han and Chewy, Michael and Dwight, Penny and Brain, Wayne and Garth, Rumi Mira Zoey and Bobby, The Dude and Walter, Pooh and Piglet, Jay and Silent Bob, Fry and Bender, or Wallace and Gromit ( — who were, yes, highly attuned to the lunar immortality of cheese)... Making a grilled cheese on sourdough and dipping it in tomato soup is basically like discovering Mario's infinite lives staircase. updates.text: "My mule don't like people laughin'. Gets the crazy notion that people are laughin' at him." Burritos are no laughing matter....especially on NATIONAL BURRITO DAY! The word "burrito" means "little donkey" in Spanish, and while the origins of that name are long debated, there's no doubt that the tightly wrapped bundle of goodness does resemble the bedrolls carried by mules and donkeys in the desert-rambling days of yore. The burrito traces its origins to northern Mexican cooking. They were likely born in Sonora, a wheat-growing region where flour tortillas were the default, and were smaller than the overstuffed, foil-wrapped cathedral of fillings that emerged in San Francisco's Mission District in the 1960s. These days you can tell a burrito by its regional dialect. In Tucson, it is a "burro" and filled with machaca. In Texas, it rolls up at high noon, smothered in enchilada sauce, squinting a challenge for you to quick draw your fork. In New Mexico, you might be asked, "red or green?" In San Diego, there might be shrimp in it. In San Francisco, it is nearly the size of an actual donkey. Rice? No rice? Just veggies? Mushrooms? Salmon?!? Like many dishes we have come to wrap our arms around, the burrito is no longer just one thing. The large flour tortilla is a canvas upon which cooks of different cultures and different cities have been painting for over a century. And while we may laugh together over our burritos, we at HungerRush strongly recommend not laughing at them. Because while you might understand that we were just playin' around, the burrito just doesn't get it. If you are a slinger of burritos, today is your day! Looking for more food holidays to celebrate? We have you covered. We put together a comprehensive National Food Day Calendar worth bookmarking: https://hubs.li/Q049swH00

updates.text: Happy #NationalCheeseDay ! 🧀💛 It takes time, tradition, and an incredible amount of dedication to produce your savory favorites—and at Great Lakes Cheese, our family of employee-owners puts that dedication into practice every single day with every package we produce. As the nation’s leading natural cheese packager, we are proud to provide an affordable, nutritious staple that fuels families across the country. In fact, you’ve likely enjoyed our cheese without even knowing it! From the melted perfection on top of a slice from your local pizza shop to the packs you grab off the shelf at your go-to grocer, our hands help craft the products that bring people together. According to the International Dairy Foods Association (IDFA), the American cheese industry has grown into a phenomenal powerhouse, with more than one-third of all U.S. milk production dedicated to cheese. We are honored to lead the way, growing alongside consumer appetites while staying true to the craft and quality behind every single block. From our plants to your plate, thank you for making what we do possible!

This month we pause to celebrate survivors, honor those still fighting, and stand in solidarity with everyone whose life has been touched by breast cancer. Early detection saves lives. If you have not scheduled your screening, let this be your reminder. 🎀 To every fighter, survivor, and supporter in our CEC Entertainment family — we see you, we celebrate you, and we are cheering you on every step of the way. #WearPink #PinkOutDay #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth #NoOneFightsAlone #PinkForCaring

updates.text: We have some exciting news to share! 🎉 Please join us in congratulating Randy Forsythe on his promotion to President & Chief Operating Officer of CEC Entertainment! In this expanded role, Randy will lead Field Operations, Global Sourcing and Purchasing, the Games Department, Construction, Learning & Development, Marketing, Brand Licensing, Information Technology, International Franchise, as well as the Peter Piper Pizza business. Randy's story is one for the books. He first walked through our doors in 1982 when the company was still known as Showbiz Pizza, and he has been a part of our family ever since. When he started, we had 37 restaurants. Today, we have more than 500 locations around the world — and Randy's fingerprints are on so much of that growth. Over more than four decades, Randy has held roles across the company that have helped shape the Chuck E. Cheese experience that families know and love today. He has always said that people are his greatest asset, and that the relationships built across this company are like family. That philosophy shows in everything he does. Congratulations, Randy. Here's to the next chapter! 🧡 #ChuckECheese #Leadership #Congratulations #FamilyEntertainment

updates.text: We're back with our Intern Spotlight! 🌟 At CEC Entertainment, an internship is more than a line on a resume. It's where careers begin, communities are built, and people find their place. 🧡 This week we are spotlighting four incredible members of our intern family, and one who never really left. Meet Tyson Gardner , Kennedi Foreman , Rachel Chavarin , Lila, and Becka! 💻 Tyson hit the ground running with his biggest project yet — tracking down the source of targeted scams on our employees and helping put a stop to them. He loves that executives are approachable, everyone is helpful, and highlighted his manager, Adam Sullivan , for being down to earth, making introductions, and giving Tyson the space to shine. 🤝 Kennedi loves that the little wins get celebrated just as much as the big ones here. She highlighted the sense of community, appreciates never feeling intimidated asking questions, and loves that hard work and fun coexist at CEC. 🌱 Rachel has grown her communication skills working closely alongside her co-workers Perla Castillo and MacKayla Harris and discovered a future career goal of becoming a Benefits Analyst along the way. She also loved getting to make her own pizza in store and see how our fun centers operate firsthand. 👥 Lila loves that nobody is ever just doing one thing here. She highlights a culture where everyone wears many hats, pitches in where needed, and shows up happy to do it. ✨ And then there is Becka, our full circle moment. She started at the store level, worked her way up to an Intern, and currently works as an HR I-9 Administrator. 20 years never flew by faster! Her highlights have been the people that show genuine care, building family bonds with her teams, and the leaders that believe in you and push you to keep growing. She loves that every day is different and that at Chuck E. Cheese, everyone is welcomed and celebrated. Our interns are not just passing through. They are part of something that lasts. And for some, this is only the beginning. 🌟 #NationalInternDay #InternSpotlight #CECEntertainment #ChuckECheese #MoreThanAnInternship #CareerDevelopment #CompanyCulture #NextGenTalent

updates.text: It's time for our Intern Spotlight! 🌟 At CEC Entertainment, our interns don't just observe — they learn by doing. As we approach National Intern Day on July 30th, we are shining a light on a few of the incredible interns each week who have been part of our team this summer. Meet Jerry, Joseph, Eric, and Chandler! Here's a glimpse at a few of the skills they've each been building: 🎨 Jerry has been leveling up his web design skills, learning how to build wireframes using Figma. 🔧 Joseph discovered a genuine passion for cable work during our recent office move — sometimes the best opportunities come when you least expect them! 💻 Eric has gotten hands-on experience in our testing labs, learning how we evaluate and implement new technology programs before they ever reach our fun centers. 📣 Chandler has been mastering the art of media pitching, learning the do's and don'ts of reaching out to journalists and telling our story the right way. Since launching our internship program in 2021, we've had the privilege of welcoming 106 interns through our doors. We could not be more proud of the talent, curiosity, and energy they bring to our team every single day. Join us in celebrating Jerry Medireck, MFA , Joseph Tran , Eric Tran , and Chandler Bailey ! 🧡 #NationalInternDay #InternSpotlight #CECEntertainment #ChuckECheese #Interns #NextGenTalent #LearnByDoing

updates.text: Chuck E. Cheese is thrilled to announce our recognition from DFW Child for Best Party Venue for Younger Kids in Dallas and Tarrant County! Being recognized by the community we love serving makes this award extra special. From the decorations to the games to the birthday song, every detail matters — and this recognition is a reflection of the team members who bring that magic to life every single day. We know how much birthdays mean to families. In a survey of nearly 1,900 parents, 51% say lighting the candles on the cake is the number one "proof-of-success" moment at their child's birthday. That number jumps to 76% for kids ages 6 and 7, when children are most aware of its social significance. That singular moment is something we take seriously, and something we deliver exceptionally every single day. Add to that the fact that 69% of parents say safety is a top priority, and 77% say making sure their child feels centered is another — and you will understand why families keep coming back to us. That is why we put just as much intention into the first 60 seconds of every visit. From the moment a birthday child walks through our doors, we make sure they feel like the star of the show — because we know that first impression sets the tone for everything that follows. From affordable packages for every budget, to live shows with Chuck E. that guarantee the brightest birthday smiles, to our newest Sensory Sensitive Birthdays designed to make every child's celebration feel just right for them, we are proud to be the home of birthdays that truly matter. Thank you to DFWChild and our DFW families for your continued support and for trusting us to create fun-filled memories with every visit. We promise to keep the fun coming! 🎂🎈 Find more of our birthday research below! https://lnkd.in/g5viYJ4D #ChuckECheese #DFWChild #BestPartyVenue #DallasMoms #TarrantCounty #BirthdayParty #SensorySensitive #FamilyFun #WhereAKidCanBeAKid

updates.text: This June, we're proud to partner with The Toy Foundation to make play more than a moment. Through June 30, guests at Chuck E. Cheese locations across the U.S. and Canada can donate at checkout to support children facing hardship — and help bring the gift of toys and play to kids who need it most. $5 donation = 500 e-tickets toward prizes. $1 or $3 options available now through June 30. International Day of Play on June 11 reminded us why this mission matters. But we didn't want to stop at one day. Because when kids play, they grow. They connect. They thrive. Thank you to every guest who's given back this month — and to our partners at The Toy Foundation™ for helping us put purpose into play. There's still time to be part of it. 💛 👉 Visit your nearest Chuck E. Cheese before June 30 to donate in-store! #PlayWithPurpose #TheToyFoundation #InternationalDayOfPlay #ChuckECheese #WhereAKidCanBeAKid https://lnkd.in/gQUmWs3U

updates.text: Game on! 🎮 We're thrilled to announce a first-of-its-kind partnership with asmodee , bringing the beloved card game Spot It! to life in an entirely new way this summer. Starting this June, Spot It! is leaving the kitchen table and coming to more than 500 Chuck E. Cheese fun centers across the U.S. and Canada. We’re transforming a game night classic into a multi-platform, immersive experience that spans interactive dance floor activations, in-venue gameplay segments on the CEC Media Network, take-home activities, and a national sweepstakes. It's the largest location-based entertainment activation in Spot It!'s history, and we couldn't be more excited about bringing it to families this summer. We're proud to welcome asmodee to the Chuck E. Cheese family this summer. Here's to a season full of play! Read the full announcement here: https://lnkd.in/gCxjzugs #ChuckECheese #SpotIt #Asmodee #FamilyEntertainment #Partnership #LocationBasedEntertainment #Summer2026

updates.text: Happy #NationalCheeseDay ! 🧀💛 It takes time, tradition, and an incredible amount of dedication to produce your savory favorites—and at Great Lakes Cheese, our family of employee-owners puts that dedication into practice every single day with every package we produce. As the nation’s leading natural cheese packager, we are proud to provide an affordable, nutritious staple that fuels families across the country. In fact, you’ve likely enjoyed our cheese without even knowing it! From the melted perfection on top of a slice from your local pizza shop to the packs you grab off the shelf at your go-to grocer, our hands help craft the products that bring people together. According to the International Dairy Foods Association (IDFA), the American cheese industry has grown into a phenomenal powerhouse, with more than one-third of all U.S. milk production dedicated to cheese. We are honored to lead the way, growing alongside consumer appetites while staying true to the craft and quality behind every single block. From our plants to your plate, thank you for making what we do possible!

updates.text: Owner’s Head of AI Developer Experience, Max Schwenk , writes about tsrs: a Rust port of TypeScript’s typechecker that cut our monorepo’s typecheck from 80 seconds to 7 seconds. Cloudflare and VoidZero (acquired by Cloudflare) are taking over tsrs as part of Oxc, in close collaboration with the TypeScript team. Coding agents wrote tsrs. In our codebase, it was 9.8× faster and used 6.6× less memory than Typescript 7.0 Previously, even with 36 GiB of memory, engineers couldn't run several agents in parallel without risking their machine locking up. We came up with mitigations, none of which seemed like a long-term scalable solution. tsrs allows us to run more agents working in parallel on our laptops and in our cloud sandboxes. For Owner, these typecheck and lint changes are projected to save hundreds of thousands of dollars a year. Across large TypeScript codebases, that could add up to hundreds of millions over time. How tsrs came together: https://lnkd.in/gNJ4RTEP

updates.text: I've joined Owner as Chief Revenue Officer. I've spent my career thinking about what makes a company worth building, and for me, it always starts with the customer. Local business owners are some of the most inspiring people there are. They took a chance on a dream, they serve their communities, and they are trying to build something that lasts. They deserve the benefits of scale and technology, and for too long, technology has failed to serve them. That is what drew me to Owner. Restaurants, where we are starting, are a massive market, and the problem Owner solves is both simple to say and very hard to do. Systematic growth for local businesses. More traffic, more conversion, more repeat customers. What also drew me in is how Owner builds. There is a real difference between a traditional software company sprinkling in AI so it can call itself an AI company and a company that is genuinely AI-native. Owner is the second kind. I have been blown away by our product velocity. The average engineer here is 400% more productive than they were even back in November of 2025, and we have pulled half of our 2027 roadmap forward into today. That creates a rare and exciting set of go-to-market problems. The question is not "when will the product ship and how do we sell it?" It is "how do we build a go-to-market system that can absorb this pace of innovation and transmit that value to the customer as fast as we create it?" There is no playbook for that. And that is exactly what makes this such an extraordinary time to build at Owner. I'm grateful for the opportunity to build with the incredible team here. The passion, energy, and talent in this organization are truly unique, and it's a privilege to build alongside them. A special thanks to Adam Guild and Rob Lehman for their partnership through the process and their trust in me. We are hiring across the go-to-market organization. Check out the roles, and let us know if you want to be part of a truly extraordinary company. Link in the comments.

updates.text: Owner has raised $240M, reached a $2.3B valuation, and crossed $100M ARR. Goldman Sachs Alternatives led the round, joined by Meritech, Redpoint, Headline, & Jack Altman. The world is racing to build AI to replace people’s jobs. Owner is building AI to do the opposite: To do the jobs for small business owners they’ve never been able to afford. I started building what would become Owner at 17, to help my mom. We've now helped thousands of local business owners like her. This year alone, more than $1 billion dollars will be made by local restaurant owners using Owner. We wouldn’t be here without our team, investors, and earliest supporters. Thank you to: Jack Altman , Jason M. Lemkin , Alex Bard , Dylan Field , Fidji Simo , Max Mullen , Shalini Rao , Alex Kurland , Naval Ravikant, Jonathan Neman , Claire Hughes Johnson , Dharmesh Shah , Cory Levy , John Andrew Entwistle, Andrew Steele , Joshua Browder , Sean Rad , Scott Belsky , Brett Schulman , Mike Vichich , Andy Pforzheimer , Harris Pollack , Stephen Kerns, Kimbal Musk , Max Altman , Ben Braverman , Geoff Donaker , Nick Bunick , Alexis Ohanian Sr. , Kipp Bodnar , Ankur Nagpal , Henry Schuck , Parker Conrad , Justin Mateen , Marcus Lemonis , Shaan Puri , Sam Parr , Tanay Tandon , Josh R. on, Josh R. , Immad Akhund , Garrett Langley , Guillermo Rauch . Dean Bloembergen , the team, and I are deeply grateful for everyone who has supported us, including those not tagged here. Owner exists to close the gap between small businesses and huge corporations. We’re starting with restaurant owners. They represent the American dream. 80% start as cooks or servers, then become first-time business owners. But they’re forced to compete with massive corporations, which spend billions on tech & marketing and hire entire teams of experts. We don't want local businesses to get crushed. Owner gives AI superpowers to small businesses, doing work they could never afford before, so they can do more than compete. They can win.

updates.text: So excited to share that Owner.com has closed a $240M Series D led by Goldman Sachs, reaching a $2.3B valuation. Everyone is debating how many jobs AI can cut. That’s why it has been so motivating to spend every day asking a very different question: how we can use AI to help independent business owners grow and create jobs? I eat at Ashley’s Cafe (pictured) multiple times a week, and seeing the impact of our technology on Ashley’s business has been pure joy. It’s a front-row-seat to a movement that Owner is building - over 100 million guests that we’ve been able to bring to small businesses across the country. I really believe local business owners are the most inspiring people on earth, and it’s a privilege to build for them. Today we celebrate a fun milestone, and then we get right back to building for these amazing entrepreneurs. If you want to come build AI for (not against) people - we’re hiring. Careers page in the comments.

updates.text: We are pleased to announce that our Growth Equity team has led a $240 million financing round in Owner, an AI-native software company building the operations platform for every local business. Owner provides small businesses, starting with restaurants, with access to AI-powered technology and automation capabilities that have historically been accessible only to larger enterprises, helping local business owners manage and grow more efficiently. This investment will help support Owner's continued product innovation and expansion as it scales across the restaurant industry and extends its offerings to new geographies and additional local business categories. updates.text: Excited to share I've joined Owner.com as Chief Talent Officer! Across my time building teams, one thing has been constant: it all comes down to exceptional people with big ambitions. So when thinking about my next chapter, I looked for three things. #1 - A mission I'd be proud of. So much of AI today lives on screens, chatbots, copilots, tools for people who already work in tech. Owner is bringing AI to the real world. The taqueria on your corner. The family pizza shop. The physical spaces where people actually gather, eat, and live. These owners are experts at their craft, but they're competing against chains with entire technology teams. Owner puts that same firepower in their hands, so they can stay competitive and succeed. #2 - A massive opportunity. Local business is one of the largest and most human parts of the economy, and it's been severely underserved. AI will change that, and will shape what our neighborhoods and main streets look like for decades. Owner is building tools that raise a business owner's odds of success. Starting with restaurants, and eventually every local business. #3 - People I'd be lucky to work with. Adam Guild and Dean have built a company centered on exceptional talent, anchored by a value that immediately struck me: "Bring good energy." Every conversation with Rob , Quenton , Lauren , William , Katie , Darrin , Wyatt and the team confirmed it. These are people you want to spend long hours and late nights with. They obsess over customers, move with urgency, and hold an exceptionally high bar I'm excited to protect and raise. Grateful to everyone over the years who have shaped how I think about talent. And to the Ownerds who've been so welcoming, we are building something epic! Of course, we're hiring. Come build with us!

linkedin_company.about: Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing and distributing food and related products to customers who prepare meals away from home. This includes restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues, and more. Sysco operates almost 340 distribution centers, in over 10 countries, with 76,000 colleagues serving approximately 730,000 customer locations. The company generated sales of more than $81 billion in fiscal year 2025 that ended June 28, 2025. As the world’s largest food-away-from-home distributor, Sysco offers customized supply chain solutions, bespoke specialty product offerings, and culinary support to drive customers to innovate and optimize their operations. Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing and distributing food and related products to customers who prepare meals away from home. This includes restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues, and more. Sysco operates almost 340 distribution centers, in over 10 countries, with 76,000 colleagues serving approximately 730,000 customer locations. The company generated sales of more than $81 billion in fiscal year 2025 that ended June 28, 2025.

As the world’s largest food-away-from-home distributor, Sysco offers customized supply chain solutions, bespoke specialty product offerings, and culinary support to drive customers to innovate and optimize their operations. We act as a trusted business partner to our customers, helping them grow through our industry-leading portfolio that includes fresh produce, premium proteins, specialty products, sustainably focused items, equipment and supplies, and innovative culinary solutions.

updates.text: For more than two decades, Domino’s® and St. Jude Children's Research Hospital - ALSAC ® have shared a belief in the power of hope. St. Jude has been Domino’s national charity partner since our first Thanks & Giving® campaign in 2004, and we are continually inspired by the generosity of our customers, franchisees and team members who help bring its lifesaving mission to life. Through this year’s campaign, customers can support children and families facing cancer and other life-threatening diseases by choosing the St. Jude Giving Combo, with $1 from each combo going to St. Jude, or by rounding up their order. Because of generous donors, families never receive a bill from St. Jude for treatment, travel, housing or food, so they can focus on what matters most: helping their child live, celebrate milestones and make memories together. Together, we can help St. Jude continue its mission: Finding cures. Saving children. ® Since the beginning of our partnership, Domino’s has raised more than $165 million for the kids of St. Jude, with a commitment to raise a total of $300 million by 2034. Join us in helping St. Jude give more children the greatest gift of all...time.

updates.text: Fire Prevention Month is here, and some Domino’s customers may get more than pizza at their door. 🚒👀 Throughout this month, participating franchise-owned stores across the U.S. are teaming up with local fire departments for surprise pizza deliveries via fire engine and free smoke alarm checks. If the customer’s smoke alarms work, the order is free. If not, firefighters will replace the batteries or install working alarms at no cost. Either way, it’s a win! For 19 years, we’ve proudly partnered with the National Fire Protection Association ( NFPA ) and local fire departments to promote fire safety. Thank you to the NFPA and firefighters nationwide for helping keep our customers and communities safe.

updates.text: The People Behind the Product: Meet Cory Behind every Grande product is a dedicated Associate who takes pride in getting the details right. For Cory, being a cheesemaker means never taking shortcuts. From monitoring the precision of the cheesemaking process to knowing when a batch meets Grande's standards, his role combines experience, skill, and attention to detail. "What surprises people most is how precise cheesemaking really is," says Cory. "If one parameter is off by even a little bit, it affects the cheese." After working hard to become a cheesemaker, Cory has developed a genuine passion for the craft and takes pride in knowing every batch is made with quality, care, and consistency. When asked what he wants consumers to know, his answer is simple: "Every single batch is made with pride and passion." #Grande #ManufacturingMonth

updates.text: The People Behind the Product: Meet Val Behind every Grande product is a dedicated Associate who takes pride in making it the best it can be. For Valerie, every piece of hand-tied cheese represents a commitment to craftsmanship, quality, and tradition. After 13 years at Grande, her passion for learning and taking on new challenges led her to become an expert at the hand-tying process. Hand-tying is a traditional artisan process where each cheese is individually rope-tied, smoked, and cured. It's work that requires patience and attention to detail, something Val enjoys most about the role. When asked what makes her proud of the work she does, her answer is simple: "Great team, great cheese, and great pride.” #Grande #ManufacturingMonth

updates.text: We’ve brought reinforcement learning into DoorDash’s real-time dispatch system to improve batching efficiency while maintaining delivery quality. Trained offline on delayed marketplace outcomes, our RL policy adjusts dispatch objective weights for each merchant. Our existing optimizer handles feasibility and operational constraints. Authors Haochen W. , Yi H. , and Ryan Xie share the engineering behind this deployment. The work was also presented at the ICML 2026 RLxF workshop. updates.text: How do you scale real-time dispatch when demand can exceed processing capacity by nearly 4x? DoorDash engineers rearchitected our dispatch platform from a centralized execution model into a distributed, horizontally scalable system designed for real-time logistics optimization. The new architecture delivers 10x greater throughput, keeps dispatch fast and predictable at peak volume, and creates a foundation for more advanced ML and reinforcement learning in the dispatch loop. In this engineering deep dive, we share how we approached distributed compute, hierarchical decomposition, shadow testing, and production rollout for one of DoorDash’s most latency-sensitive systems. Read the full post: https://lnkd.in/gCaqbmVs

linkedin_company.about: With 2,500 employees and net sales of $1.7 billion, Sargento is a family-owned, privately-held company that has been an innovator in cheese for more than 70 years. Founded in 1953 in Plymouth, Wisconsin, Sargento successfully introduced America to pre-packaged sliced and shredded natural cheeses. Today, Sargento is still based in Wisconsin, where they manufacture and market amazing shredded, sliced and snack natural cheese products, as well as ingredients. Company leadership lives to serve local communities and employees who are part of the Sargento Family.

updates.text: Today - October 23 - marks 73 years since our company was founded in 1953. What began as a small family business has become a business family whose impact can be felt far beyond our hometown of Plymouth, Wisconsin. The visionary thinking of Leonard A. Gentine who married Dolores Becker and started a family in Plymouth, set into a motion an enterprise that would forever change how America enjoys natural cheese. Leonard's winning spirit, produced a long line of industry firsts. His earliest innovations included custom equipment for cutting and packaging cheese, adapting a pasta cutter to automate shredding and pioneering gas-flushed packaging to help preserve freshness. Over time, Sargento was the first company to successfully mass produce pre-packaged sliced and shredded natural cheese. Today Leonard's grandson, our Chairman and CEO Louie Gentine , continues his vision as we strive to be the most innovative, best-loved real food company. From our Ultra Thin® slices, to Balanced Breaks® snacks to Sargento®Natural American cheese slices, our goal has remained consistent: listen closely, solve real needs and add value to our stakeholder's lives. Thank you to everyone - past and present - who has helped us reach this milestone and be come one of Fast Company 's 'World's Most Innovative Companies' this year. See our History of Innovation at Sargento: https://lnkd.in/g7xRsVjc #SargentoFamily #innovation #CEO #cheese #anniversary

updates.text: We're proud to share that we've earned three prestigious workplace rankings: America’s Greatest Workplaces in Manufacturing 2026, America’s Greatest Workplaces, and America’s Greatest Workplaces by State 2026 (Wisconsin) by Newsweek. "National Manufacturing Month is the perfect occasion to celebrate our teams in operations and our history,” said Louie Gentine , 3rd generation Chairman and CEO of Sargento. "Manufacturing is how Sargento began with my grandfather, Leonard Gentine, who was a machinist by trade. He saw a need for consumer-sized packages of natural cheese, and he created processes and machinery that were ahead of their time to bring his vision to life. Being recognized by Newsweek across these three categories is a true testament to the foundation he laid for us and our culture. Today, our manufacturing teams continue that spirit of innovation and continuous improvement to deliver high-quality natural cheese to families across the country." These three honors reflect our legacy of manufacturing excellence, culture of innovation, and commitment to employees across production, packaging, and technical facilities in Plymouth, Kiel, Hilbert, Elkhart Lake, and St. Cloud, Wis. Congratulations Sargento Family. Read our full press release: https://lnkd.in/gMYm8zUE

updates.text: Fun fact: Wisconsin Governor Tony Evers worked at Sargento many years ago. Today, the governor returned to our shared hometown of Plymouth to break ground with our Chairman and CEO Louie Gentine on new workforce housing: 102 single family homes in a new subdivision called Scholar’s Ridge. For several years, building more entry-level housing in Sheboygan County has been a key focus of ours alongside others in our business community. That’s why we invested $2 million to help create the Sheboygan County Economic Development Corporation ’s (SCEDC) ‘Forward Fund’ which made this moment possible. Scholar’s Ridge is the third subdivision developed through SCEDC’s housing Intitiative, geared toward Wisconsin’s workforce. Each home will be priced to provide affordable homeownership opportunities for working families. We’re excited for the future and look forward to welcoming more families and opportunity to Sheboygan County. https://lnkd.in/gDSRdG_F #SargentoFamily #housing #CEO #cheese

updates.text: We're feeling good this Friday, grateful for our community partners: Hunger Task Force and Pauls Pantry . Our 3rd annual 'Touchdowns for Hunger' Day of Action in partnership with the Green Bay Packers , brought us to Hunger Task Force's farm in Franklin, Wisconsin where we harvested more than 1,300 pounds of apples to feed families statewide. Hunger Task Force has operated this 200+ acre farm since 2012 to provide seasonal fresh produce to its hunger relief network across Wisconsin and our Tribal nations. Thank you for your time, Lenny. As the Official Cheese of the Packers and a family-owned company, we strive to make a difference off the field in areas that matter most. #GoPackGo #SargentoFamily cc: Jon Murphy , Tyler McCune , Amanda Wery , Jonathan Hansen , Mardi Smirl , Robert Hornacek , Peggy Osthelder , Addison Lund , Phillip Bock, Portia Young

updates.text: Today we announce our acquisition of La Terra Fina , maker of premium dairy-based dips, spreads and quiches. The acquisition expands our portfolio into grocery and club deli departments, and creates a Deli Business Unit alongside Consumer Products and Food Service & Ingredients. We are honored to also welcome approximately 250 new employees in Union City, CA to the Sargento Family. “For three generations, Sargento has built our success through industry-leading innovation and a real commitment to our stakeholders,” said Louie Gentine , our 3rd generation Chairman and CEO. “Entering the Deli is an exciting opportunity for the Sargento Family, that expands our capabilities, builds on the strength of the La Terra Fina® brand and brings new consumers to Sargento.” The closing of the sale has sparked promotions and new leadership roles across our three business units: Consumer Products, Food Service & Ingredients and today, Deli. “The acquisition of La Terra Fina represents an important milestone and growth engine for Sargento. It will strengthen our ability to deliver value for our employees, customers, suppliers and shareholders,” said COO Michael Pellegrino . “I want to congratulate Erin, Jeremy and Joy on their new roles as we align our leadership structure to support this exciting venture. Their leadership and expertise will help us welcome La Terra Fina to the Sargento Family, serve our stakeholders and continue positioning our company for long-term growth.” cc: Erin Price , Jeremy Schellin , Joy Judski Read our full press release: https://lnkd.in/gUZyg2q4 #SargentoFamily | #businessnews | #leadership | #CEO | #cheese

I am confident they will lead Sargento with integrity and a commitment to the principles my grandfather, Leonard Gentine, instilled in our company from the very beginning.” As Gerard (Rod) Hogan prepares to retire in January 2027, we thank him for the incredible impact he's had on Sargento through his leadership, innovation, and commitment to developing others. His contributions were recently recognized with the Founder's Ring, our highest honor. updates.text: A POS without built-in text marketing is like a margarita without tequila. It's basically just a glass full of lime juice and salt. Long gone are the days when a restaurant POS was a sleek cash register. Nearly every customer interaction passes through a modern POS in some form, accumulating a continuous record of guest behavior. When guest communication tools like text marketing are built in to that environment to create a unified marketing engine, marketing messages can be defined by what guests have actually done rather than by static assumptions. If marketing tools need to be bolted on to that environment...lime juice and salt. And did you know that text messages have a 95-99% read rate? For more delicious stats and more about how a modern POS can take advantage of customer behavior data to drive growth, check out this article on SourceForge .

updates.text: Is it time to renew your POS contract? Before you do, here are a few questions worth asking. Does your POS scale? Your system should grow with you — not force you to rebuild menus and workflows every time you open a new store. Does your POS improve accuracy? Does it handle complex modifiers, a high volume of online orders, delivery, and driver dispatch without slowing you down or causing mistakes? Does your POS integrate? Is your team drowning in tablets? If everything lives in separate systems, that’s a workaround that doesn’t really work. Does your POS give you visibility? Can you see at-a-glance what’s happening across all of your stores and can you trust the numbers you’re seeing? Does your POS make you more visible? The customer data YOU ALREADY HAVE should flow seamlessly into a complete marketing and loyalty system. If you answered “no” to any of these questions, your POS isn’t a partner — it’s a problem, and it may be time to consider a refresh. Looking for a real POS partner? HungerRush is the POS partner behind every great guest experience. Get in touch.

updates.text: "A cheese may disappoint. It may be dull, it may be naive, it may be oversophisticated. Yet it remains cheese, milk's leap toward immortality." — Clifton Fadiman If you believe you are what you eat, then National Grilled Cheese Day is the perfect moment to shave off (...or unwrap...) a slice of immortality, melt it between two pieces of bread, and digest the divine. And tomato soup? Like Batman and Robin, Lucy and Ethel, Mario and Luigi, Frodo and Samwise, Han and Chewy, Michael and Dwight, Penny and Brain, Wayne and Garth, Rumi Mira Zoey and Bobby, The Dude and Walter, Pooh and Piglet, Jay and Silent Bob, Fry and Bender, or Wallace and Gromit ( — who were, yes, highly attuned to the lunar immortality of cheese)... While not officially "required" for a proper National Grilled Cheese Day celebration, that steady bowl of tomato soup is the classic lawful-good force multiplier. The OG 10xer. And is now a good time to talk about sourdough being bread's own leap toward immortality as well? Making a grilled cheese on sourdough and dipping it in tomato soup is basically like discovering Mario's infinite lives staircase. If you're reading this on April 12th, today is the day to make an Artemis-like leap toward your own immortality. Looking for other days to celebrate your favorite foods? updates.text: "My mule don't like people laughin'. Gets the crazy notion that people are laughin' at him." Burritos are no laughing matter....especially on NATIONAL BURRITO DAY! The word "burrito" means "little donkey" in Spanish, and while the origins of that name are long debated, there's no doubt that the tightly wrapped bundle of goodness does resemble the bedrolls carried by mules and donkeys in the desert-rambling days of yore. The burrito traces its origins to northern Mexican cooking. They were likely born in Sonora, a wheat-growing region where flour tortillas were the default, and were smaller than the overstuffed, foil-wrapped cathedral of fillings that emerged in San Francisco's Mission District in the 1960s. These days you can tell a burrito by its regional dialect. In Tucson, it is a "burro" and filled with machaca. In Texas, it rolls up at high noon, smothered in enchilada sauce, squinting a challenge for you to quick draw your fork. In New Mexico, you might be asked, "red or green?" In San Diego, there might be shrimp in it. In San Francisco, it is nearly the size of an actual donkey. Rice? No rice? Just veggies? Mushrooms? Salmon?!? Like many dishes we have come to wrap our arms around, the burrito is no longer just one thing. The large flour tortilla is a canvas upon which cooks of different cultures and different cities have been painting for over a century. And while we may laugh together over our burritos, we at HungerRush strongly recommend not laughing at them. Because while you might understand that we were just playin' around, the burrito just doesn't get it. If you are a slinger of burritos, today is your day! Looking for more food holidays to celebrate? We have you covered. We put together a comprehensive National Food Day Calendar worth bookmarking: https://hubs.li/Q049swH00

linkedin_company.about: In 1978, Eugene Jetts was on his way to buy a new home when his passion for pizza changed his plans. Instead, he signed a lease on a space in Sterling Heights, Michigan, and, alongside his brother and partner John, opened the first Jetts Party Shoppe & Pizzeria. That family-owned beginning became the foundation for what would grow into Jet’s Pizza®. More than 45 years later, Jet’s remains rooted in its Detroit beginnings, family values and commitment to making great pizza the right way. With more than 400 locations across the country, we’re still focused on the details that have always set us apart: dough made fresh daily, premium mozzarella hand-grated in our stores, quality ingredients and our signature Detroit-style crust, baked until it’s crisp, golden and caramelized around the edges. And while our famous Detroit-style pizza put us on the map, there’s more to Jet’s than square slices. From hand-tossed round, thin-crust and NY Style pizzas to fresh salads, breads, desserts and more, we’re always looking for ways to give our guests something worth coming back for. From one family’s passion for pizza to a growing brand with deep roots in the communities we serve, we’re proud of where we came from — and even more excited about where we’re going. It’s Not Pizza. It’s Jet’s.®

updates.text: Some moments go beyond our stores and remind us just how meaningful our Jet’s family can be. This past weekend, one of our corporate franchise teams came together to support Relay For Life and honor the memory of Julie, a former Jet’s driver and beloved member of their team who lost her battle with cancer on August 8th. Store leadership Victoria, Andrew, Alexis, and Kaycie came together to honor Julie, with Kaycie carrying a particularly personal connection as Julie’s daughter. In Julie’s memory, the team donated $1,000 to the American Cancer Society and joined their community in supporting a cause that touches so many lives. We’re grateful to see our teams show up for one another and the communities they’re part of. We’re honored to share Julie’s story and celebrate the impact she had on those around her. We’ll be cheering them on as they return for Relay For Life next year. 💜 #RelayForLife #JetsPizza #CommunityImpact

updates.text: Some of the best high school memories happen after the final whistle. 🏆🍕 That’s why we’re proud to be named the Official Pizza of the Michigan High School Athletic Association (MHSAA). Born in Sterling Heights in 1978, Jet’s has grown across the country, but Michigan will always be home. And there’s something special about the way high school sports bring Michigan communities together, from Friday night lights to state championship celebrations. Through this multiyear partnership, we’ll be celebrating the student-athletes, coaches, teams, and communities that make Michigan high school sports so special. Throughout the school year, the MHSAA will recognize a Team of the Month, and we’ll be celebrating each honoree with a Jet’s Pizza party and a spotlight across our social channels. Here’s to the teams, the towns, the traditions, and all the memories still to be made! Michigan, we’re proud to be in your corner. 💙 #JetsPizza #MHSAA #MichiganHighSchoolSports #Michigan

linkedin_company.about: At Mutti, we believe in the importance of recognising the worth of what may seem ordinary, but never truly is - the soil, the tomatoes, and the small, daily gestures that, over time, make a real difference. Behind every product lies a long-term commitment, built with care and patience. Not to chase short-time success, but to leave something meaningful for the future. Mutti is currently the most beloved tomato brand in Europe, dedicated to the processing of 100% Italian tomatoes. For 125 years, the company has been a tomato specialist, always owned and run by the Mutti family. Now led by the fourth generation, it continues to uphold the values that have made the brand so well-loved. Today, Mutti is the leading group in the tomato-based products market in Italy and Europe, with operations in over 100 countries. The Company has always focused on quality, investing in research and innovation. To ensure the quality of its tomatoes, Mutti upholds a procurement policy that pays a premium price to all suppliers capable of delivering superior quality tomatoes. In addition, for more than 25 years the Company has promoted the “Pomodorino d’Oro”, an incentive that goes far beyond a monetary reward – serving as a source of motivation and economical support that brings pride and new sources for investments to the farmers who are dedicated to producing this iconic excellence of Italian food. The Pomodorino d’Oro also stands as a testament to the strong bond Mutti shares with its farmers, reflecting a relationship built on trust and genuine human connection. Working for Mutti means becoming part of a business experiencing a sustainable international growth – yet, at the heart of this expansion is steadfast commitment to what truly matters: the quality of our products, along with economic sustainability. We grow and broaden our reach because we are confident in our ability to do so responsibly, maintaining the same exceptional standards while pursuing a long-term vision.

updates.text: Cosa c’è dietro una lattina di Polpa Mutti? Molto più di quanto si possa immaginare. Insieme a Geopop siamo entrati nel cuore della nostra stagione del pomodoro, partendo dai campi e seguendo il viaggio dei nostri pomodori fino al nostro stabilimento di Montechiarugolo. updates.text: LA CAMPAGNA DEL POMODORO 2026 È UFFICIALMENTE INIZIATA! 🍅 Dietro ogni nostro prodotto c'è un lavoro di attesa, ascolto della terra e pianificazione, che trova il suo momento più intenso in poco più di due mesi di attività continua. Quei mesi sono ufficialmente iniziati! Da qui alla fine di settembre, i nostri stabilimenti lavoreranno a pieno ritmo per accogliere il miglior pomodoro proveniente da oltre 1.000 famiglie di agricoltori italiani, trasformandolo entro un giorno dalla raccolta per preservarne tutte le sue qualità organolettiche. Uno grande sforzo collettivo, reso possibile da una filiera integrata in cui la competenza e la cura dei nostri agricoltori conferitori si uniscono all'impegno delle nostre persone e all'energia di 1.300 giovani stagionali, pronti ad affiancare i team di produzione durante questa stagione intensa e ricca di sfide. Perché la qualità non deriva da un singolo sforzo, ma dalla capacità di saper lavorare insieme, al ritmo della terra. --- THE 2026 TOMATO PROCESSING CAMPAIGN HAS OFFICIALLY BEGUN! 🍅 Behind every single one of our products lies a process of waiting, listening to the land, and careful planning, which reaches its peak during just over two months of non-stop activity. Those months have officially started! From now until the end of September, our production plants will be working at full capacity to receive the finest tomatoes from over 1,000 Italian farming families, processing them within 24 hours of harvest to preserve all of their organoleptic qualities. A great collective effort, made possible by an integrated supply chain where the expertise and dedication of our partner growers join forces with the commitment of our people and the energy of 1,300 young seasonal workers, who will support our production teams throughout this intense and challenging season. Because quality never comes from a single effort, but it comes from the ability to work together, in harmony with the rhythm of the land.

Da qui alla fine di settembre, i nostri stabilimenti lavoreranno a pieno ritmo per accogliere il miglior pomodoro proveniente da oltre 1.000 famiglie di agricoltori italiani, trasformandolo entro un giorno dalla raccolta per preservarne tutte le sue qualità organolettiche. 
Uno grande sforzo collettivo, reso possibile da una filiera integrata in cui la competenza e la cura dei nostri agricoltori conferitori si uniscono all'impegno delle nostre persone e all'energia di 1.300 giovani stagionali, pronti ad affiancare i team di produzione durante questa stagione intensa e ricca di sfide.

Perché la qualità non deriva da un singolo sforzo, ma dalla capacità di saper lavorare insieme, al ritmo della terra.

---
THE 2026 TOMATO PROCESSING CAMPAIGN HAS OFFICIALLY BEGUN! 🍅

Behind every single one of our products lies a process of waiting, listening to the land, and careful planning, which reaches its peak during just over two months of non-stop activity. Those months have officially started!

From now until the end of September, our production plants will be working at full capacity to receive the finest tomatoes from over 1,000 Italian farming families, processing them within 24 hours of harvest to preserve all of their organoleptic qualities.
A great collective effort, made possible by an integrated supply chain where the expertise and dedication of our partner growers join forces with the commitment of our people and the energy of 1,300 young seasonal workers, who will support our production teams throughout this intense and challenging season.

Because quality never comes from a single effort, but it comes from the ability to work together, in harmony with the rhythm of the land.

updates.text: Abbiamo ufficialmente dato il via ai lavori per la creazione della nostra Oasi Affiliata WWF! Un'iniziativa importante, che vedrà la progressiva trasformazione di circa 8 ettari di terreni adiacenti alla nostra sede storica di Montechiarugolo in un'area rinaturalizzata e protetta. Per noi di Mutti, essere la prima grande azienda alimentare ad aderire al programma Oasi Affiliate del WWF Italia rappresenta un traguardo significativo. Un progetto che si inserisce all'interno della nostra strategia ESG, che abbraccia l’intera filiera e rappresenta un pilastro della storica partnership che ci lega a WWF Italia dal 2010. La creazione dell'oasi, infatti, va ad ampliare ulteriormente gli interventi di ripristino ambientale e tutela della biodiversità che abbiamo già avviato negli anni scorsi. Tra questi, la "Casa delle Rondini", per sostenere la nidificazione e il rifugio di specie protette di uccelli, e la piantumazione di oltre 2.000 alberi e 5.800 arbusti, rinaturalizzando così una vasta area attorno alla nostra sede principale. Un'iniziativa che riflette appieno la nostra visione di un modello di impresa in cui l'attività produttiva coesiste e si integra sinergicamente con la salvaguardia degli ecosistemi locali. Nel lungo periodo, l'area diventerà un patrimonio condiviso con la comunità e il territorio, con l'obiettivo di favorire la diffusione della cultura della biodiversità e della sostenibilità.

updates.text: Ogni anno, durante la campagna del pomodoro, i nostri Red Tour aprono le porte dello stabilimento di Montechiarugolo ai nostri stakeholder che vogliono scoprire da vicino il percorso del pomodoro Mutti, dal campo al prodotto finito. A guidarli in questa esperienza sono le nostre Muttivoices: colleghe e colleghi che, attraverso il proprio lavoro e la propria esperienza, raccontano l'azienda in prima persona. Per prepararsi alla nuova stagione dei Red Tour, la scorsa settimana le Muttivoices hanno partecipato a una giornata di team building presso Consorzio Melinda SCA , una realtà con cui condividiamo valori importanti: attenzione alla qualità, innovazione, sostenibilità, valorizzazione della materia prima e forte legame con il territorio. Dalla visita alle sale di lavorazione della Cooperativa COBA di Denno, alle celle ipogee nel cuore delle Dolomiti, fino alla suggestiva Funivia delle Mele, la giornata è stata un'occasione preziosa per fare squadra, confrontarsi e raccogliere nuove ispirazioni per il loro ruolo di ambassador durante le visite. Grazie a Melinda per l'accoglienza e la disponibilità!

updates.text: Partecipare a TUTTOFOOD Milano , dove il cibo è protagonista assoluto, significa anche assumersi la responsabilità di gestire con attenzione le eccedenze e i prodotti che rimangono inutilizzati al termine dell'evento. Per noi di Mutti, la lotta allo spreco alimentare è un impegno quotidiano e concreto che si riflette in ogni nostra azione. Per questo, abbiamo scelto di donare il cibo in eccedenza presso il nostro stand a Banco Alimentare della Lombardia "Danilo Fossati" ODV , aderendo alla loro iniziativa #TuttofoodFoodSaving e trasformando ciò che sarebbe rimasto inutilizzato in un aiuto concreto per le persone in difficoltà sul territorio. Crediamo che il valore del cibo vada oltre la tavola: significa responsabilità e attenzione verso la comunità. Una visione che ci unisce a Banco Alimentare in una partnership solida che portiamo avanti nel tempo e che continuiamo a coltivare con orgoglio. Un ringraziamento speciale va ai 123 volontari che hanno reso possibile questa straordinaria rete di solidarietà, permettendo il recupero complessivo di circa 25 tonnellate di alimenti.
